title: spexial
details: Special functions for JAX, following the scipy.special API, filling gaps like zeta at negative integers and the modified Bessel K, Gegenbauer and polylogarithm functions.

highlight.alt: The spexial logo: a capital Gamma shaded from teal through blue to purple on a dark rounded square.
highlight.description: scipy.special in JAX: special functions on the scipy API, filling gaps such as zeta at negative integers and the modified Bessel K, Gegenbauer and polylogarithm functions.
